es-ES.description:
Organiza la compra de cada día y conserva tus listas habituales para la próxima vez.

PREPARA Y REUTILIZA
Guarda tus listas habituales y copia sus productos a una compra independiente en Inicio. Marca lo comprado, añade extras sin cambiar la guardada y retira la compra cuando termines. «Actualizar lista» conserva expresamente los cambios que quieras reutilizar.

ENCUENTRA LO QUE NECESITAS
Busca productos mientras escribes, explora el catálogo y crea productos con una foto propia. Añade cantidades y notas, pega un texto para convertirlo en productos y ajusta su tamaño en pantalla.

COMPRA JUNTOS
Comparte una lista mediante invitación y edítala desde distintos dispositivos por Internet. Los cambios se sincronizan al añadir productos o marcar lo comprado. También puedes abrir tus listas compartidas desde el navegador.

TUS LISTAS, A MANO
Las listas personales se guardan en tu dispositivo. Solo las listas que eliges compartir o usar en otros dispositivos se sincronizan en la nube. Puedes editar sin conexión y recuperar los cambios compartidos cuando vuelvas a tener Internet.

Disponible en castellano e inglés, con idioma inicial según el dispositivo.

ANUNCIOS Y SUSCRIPCIÓN OPCIONAL
La app para iPhone puede mostrar un banner de anuncios de Google, sujeto a tus opciones de privacidad. Una suscripción mensual opcional elimina los anuncios mientras esté activa. Todos los importes dan el mismo beneficio; los mayores permiten apoyar más a Cesta. Las funciones de compra y listas compartidas siguen disponibles sin suscripción. Se renueva automáticamente hasta que la canceles en tu cuenta de Apple.

Privacidad: https://krazel.github.io/cesta/privacy/
Condiciones: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

en-US.description:
Organize everyday shopping and keep your regular lists ready for next time.

PREPARE AND REUSE
Keep reusable saved lists and copy their products into independent shops on Home. Tick off bought products, add extras without changing the saved list and remove the shop when finished. “Update saved list” explicitly keeps the changes you want to reuse.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
Find catalogue suggestions as you type, browse products and create your own with a photo. Add quantities and notes, paste shopping text to turn it into items and adjust their size on screen.

SHOP TOGETHER
Share a list by invitation and edit it across devices over the Internet. Changes synchronize when you add items or tick them off. You can also open shared lists in your browser.

KEEP YOUR LISTS HANDY
Personal lists stay on your device. Only lists you choose to share or use on other devices synchronize through the cloud. Edit offline and recover shared updates when your connection returns.

Available in Spanish and English, with the initial language taken from your device.

ADS AND OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION
The iPhone app may show a Google banner subject to your privacy choices. An optional monthly subscription removes ads while active. All prices provide the same benefit; higher amounts offer additional support for Cesta. Shopping and shared-list features remain available without subscribing. Automatically renews until cancelled in your Apple account.

Privacy: https://krazel.github.io/cesta/privacy/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

reviewNotes:
Cesta is a grocery-list app in Spanish and English. No account, password or demo login is required. First launch: follow or skip the tutorial, enter a display name, then start. Saved Lists are reusable; adding one to Home creates an independent shop. Add products, tick bought items, or use Home > Paste a list to turn shopping text into products. Products include search, custom names, quantities, notes and optional chosen photos. Share a Home shop through its options > Share list; a second device can open the invitation in the iOS app or browser, or use Join. Sharing works over the Internet, not only on one Wi-Fi network. Personal lists remain local until sharing is enabled.

Settings > Remove ads offers six monthly auto-renewable subscriptions in group22489005: com.dmkr.cesta.noads.monthly.199, .499, .999, .1499, .1999 and .2499 (each suffix uses the same full prefix). They all remove the same banner while active; higher amounts are voluntary additional support and do not unlock other features. No trial. The lowest price is presented first. Prices come from StoreKit. Restore purchases, Manage subscription, Privacy and the standard Apple EULA are on this screen. Shopping and sharing do not require a subscription.

Google UMP runs after onboarding, before ad requests. If European consent permits Google personalization, the app may then ask Apple tracking permission before ads start. A regulatory refusal or unavailable/malformed signal does not trigger ATT. Without both permissions the app disables personalization and requests restricted/non-personalized ads. The privacy options can be reopened in Settings > Ad privacy when required by UMP. No shopping contents, photos, participant names or invitation credentials are sent to AdMob. Production banners use Cesta own ad unit; serving can be limited while Google verifies the new store listing. There are no interstitials. A valid paid entitlement suppresses banners. Rating requests follow meaningful use; optional ad-removal reminders are at most once per14days. Release remains manual.
